subject.title: fix(qa): repair WhatsApp live scenario regressions

question: Should the runtime-context PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110762 land before this dependent WhatsApp QA repair, or should maintainers collapse and validate the two changes as one reviewed stack?
rationale: The code change is intentionally QA-only, but its branch base is an open production runtime repair; choosing the release and proof sequence requires maintainer ownership of the combined behavior.

options.title: Land the stack in order
options.body: Merge the runtime-context repair first, then rebase this QA-only PR and confirm the targeted live fleet against the final main-based head.

options.title: Review as one combined change
options.body: Keep the stack together only if maintainers prefer one coordinated production-plus-QA validation and review decision.

recommendation.title: Land the stack in order
recommendation.body: Merge the runtime-context repair first, then rebase this QA-only PR and confirm the targeted live fleet against the final main-based head.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked runtime and QA branches and can clarify the intended stack and validation order.
